name: streamvessel-log-worker
description: StreamVessel log agent as a Cloudflare Worker: OpenSearch _bulk receiver -> Queue -> presigned upload

SV_CLIENT_ID.description: Client id of your StreamVessel log agent (`sva_…`). Create the agent in StreamVessel first.

SV_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret of that log agent (`svas_…`). StreamVessel shows it only once.

BULK_PASSWORD.description: A new password that App Platform will use to send logs here. At least 16 characters; for example the output of `openssl rand -base64 32`. You need it again when you set up log forwarding.

SV_SERVER.description: Your StreamVessel address. Keep the default unless you run your own StreamVessel.

SV_INSTANCE.description: Folder name for this Worker's files in your bucket. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`.

BULK_USER.description: User name App Platform will use to send logs here.

LOG_QUEUE.description: Queue that holds logs until they are uploaded.

DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE.description: Queue that keeps batches that could not be uploaded after many retries.
